high_level_description: The image depicts a cozy living room setting with a focus on a wooden coffee table. The coffee table is made of dark wood with a rich, polished finish. It has a rectangular shape with rounded edges and features a central drawer with a brass handle. There are two open shelves on either side of the drawer, providing additional storage space. On top of the table, there is an open book and two glasses filled with water. In the background, part of a beige sofa is visible, suggesting a comfortable seating area.
